Master switch for electron-positron annihilation, e+ e- -> gamma gamma (am3_mojo addition; not the
photon-photon annihilation into pairs of `set_process_annihilation`), with Svensson's (1982) exact rates and
photon spectra. Needs `set_process_merge_positrons_into_electrons(False)` (the default). A step's sinks and

annihilation time (`get_t_electron_annihilation()`, `get_t_positron_annihilation()`).

set_process_kaons

set_process_kaons(self: am3.AM3, arg0: bool) -> None

Master switch for kaons (am3_mojo addition): K+, K-, K0_S and K0_L from photo-hadronic interactions of
protons and neutrons and from pp collisions, their escape, cooling (synchrotron and inverse Compton for K+-)
and decay, and the decay products (pions, muons, e+-, neutrinos). Needs the photo-pion or the pp process
with its emission. With kaons on, the pion yields of the photo-hadronic multi-pion types are reduced by the
kaons' energy, and in pp collisions the protons also lose the kaons' energy.
Set to False (no kaons, as in AM3) / True. Default: True.
